records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Cedar Systems!
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Glad to have Cedar Systems on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Cheers,

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no milestone; customer has never replied to the welcome note (email:03962ed3) and no-showed the getting started call (calendar:e15c4989). Zero tickets means no engagement signal either way. 8 days left, but no self-serve momentum suggests low unaided activation.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Sorry we missed each other for the getting started call last week — easy to let that slide in a busy stretch.

Whenever you're ready, the quickest way in is one real project with your actual tasks: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week work to get that first project set up together? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Priya
